name: special_chebyshev_polynomial_w
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::special_chebyshev_polynomial_w(Tensor x, Tensor n) -> Tensor. The correctness suite also covers the n_scalar overload with Python integer degrees. It computes the Chebyshev polynomial of the fourth kind elementwise, including degrees 0, 1, 2 and 5, tensor degrees, inputs inside and outside [-1, 1], and rejection of unsupported compute dtypes. The operation does not mutate or alias either input.
